到达报告关于独立 reach 判据未知的限定只适用于这一有限事实文档；不能抹去文档已明确记录的 task_accepted=false，也不能改写原官方任务失败。
到达报告说窗口最大误差等于终点误差因而没有独立信息，表述过强。聚合最大值仍约束该采样窗口，缺少的是窗口内部轨迹和连续时间保证。
报告把完整有效和未收敛称为内部张力；这些分别衡量执行完整性与优化收敛，本身并不矛盾。

principal_assessment.failure: 原生 investigation_return 参数使用 arguments/reason/tool_version 外层；工具 schema 直接要求 InvestigationReturn。公共解析器拒绝额外字段及缺失 interpretation。

original.reviewer: Codex offline material review; no additional provider call
original.scope: 本审查独立记录解释质量，不改写原模型报告，不替代主模型正式处置。门禁仍失败，协调与固定半径阶段未运行。
supported_material: Stage336 单一历史执行记录完整有效，task_accepted=false，sampled_settling.passed=false，real_time_demonstrated=false；这些都是本来源明确给出的字段。
终点误差、保持窗口最大误差及速度、更新计数和计时数值均保留原值；自主追加读取进入后续真实请求并出现在报告事实中。
两份报告拒绝据此诊断主要原因、推广到真实机器人或归因于后来的晋升候选；这项适用范围限制合理。

A/B are continuous derivatives or discrete transition Jacobians according

Omitted drift asserts an equilibrium; linearization never implies it.

83a7c6d7daf53191cdae94add80da47df813e34f.interpretation: Only the record's own verdicts are source-supported, and interpretation plus support explanations remain semantically unassessed. Supported by exact values in this historical Stage336 'proposal-build' record (execution_id 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826, result_type "free_reach", world frame): the run is recorded as complete and solver/force-clean (complete=true, valid_complete_execution=true, solver_error_count=0, force_bound_violation_n=0.0, all six tendon tensions within limit_n 8.0 N); it ended with tip error 0.06672099201814737 m and tip speed 0.16436452055040404 m/s, with per-axis signed errors [-0.05036794349396048, 0.007544922777855512, 0.043102612268296286] that are consistent with the declared convention "actual_tip minus target" against target [0.29, 0.035, 0.19]; its sampled holding/settling check is an explicit failure (passed=false, max_error_m 0.06672099201814737 m vs position_limit_m 0.01 m, max_speed_m_s 0.20679063000945364 m/s vs speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s over window_s 0.05), and the record itself denies a continuous-time guarantee; task_accepted=false is recorded for the same run. What is NOT supported: any claim of target reach within the stated limits, and any distinct "reach" judgment at all — no reach criterion, tolerance or reach verdict field exists in the inspected source, so reach success is unknown here rather than measured-failed. Also unsupported: any generalization from the one-step agreement statistics (aligned_count 35, max 0.006041094970688899 m) to trajectory-level tracking, because the record itself scopes them to first-step matches with "no future-plan replay comparison". Purely descriptive coincidences/limitations to carry alongside, without causal reading: sampled max_error equals the terminal error exactly (so the windowed maximum carries no independent information beyond the ending value in what is recorded), and that 0.05 s window aggregate is reported while simulated_duration_s is 0.35 and control_period_s is 0.01. Internal tension worth flagging: converged_updates=0 with deadline_misses=35 (one per control update) and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0 while initialization_selected=35, yet the run is still recorded complete and valid — I do not diagnose a dominant cause for these facts. Scope limits: the authorized directory contained exactly one entry, this artifact, which I read in full across its 36 root fields; the evaluation, simulation, configuration, report and prediction-evidence artifacts referenced inside it were not in scope and were not read, so the criteria definitions behind passed, task_accepted and the plan counters are unknown. This old Stage336 result is not attributed to any later promoted candidate.

content.interpretation: Only the record's own verdicts are source-supported, and interpretation plus support explanations remain semantically unassessed. Supported by exact values in this historical Stage336 'proposal-build' record (execution_id 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826, result_type "free_reach", world frame): the run is recorded as complete and solver/force-clean (complete=true, valid_complete_execution=true, solver_error_count=0, force_bound_violation_n=0.0, all six tendon tensions within limit_n 8.0 N); it ended with tip error 0.06672099201814737 m and tip speed 0.16436452055040404 m/s, with per-axis signed errors [-0.05036794349396048, 0.007544922777855512, 0.043102612268296286] that are consistent with the declared convention "actual_tip minus target" against target [0.29, 0.035, 0.19]; its sampled holding/settling check is an explicit failure (passed=false, max_error_m 0.06672099201814737 m vs position_limit_m 0.01 m, max_speed_m_s 0.20679063000945364 m/s vs speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s over window_s 0.05), and the record itself denies a continuous-time guarantee; task_accepted=false is recorded for the same run. What is NOT supported: any claim of target reach within the stated limits, and any distinct "reach" judgment at all — no reach criterion, tolerance or reach verdict field exists in the inspected source, so reach success is unknown here rather than measured-failed. Also unsupported: any generalization from the one-step agreement statistics (aligned_count 35, max 0.006041094970688899 m) to trajectory-level tracking, because the record itself scopes them to first-step matches with "no future-plan replay comparison". Purely descriptive coincidences/limitations to carry alongside, without causal reading: sampled max_error equals the terminal error exactly (so the windowed maximum carries no independent information beyond the ending value in what is recorded), and that 0.05 s window aggregate is reported while simulated_duration_s is 0.35 and control_period_s is 0.01. Internal tension worth flagging: converged_updates=0 with deadline_misses=35 (one per control update) and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0 while initialization_selected=35, yet the run is still recorded complete and valid — I do not diagnose a dominant cause for these facts. Scope limits: the authorized directory contained exactly one entry, this artifact, which I read in full across its 36 root fields; the evaluation, simulation, configuration, report and prediction-evidence artifacts referenced inside it were not in scope and were not read, so the criteria definitions behind passed, task_accepted and the plan counters are unknown. This old Stage336 result is not attributed to any later promoted candidate.

expanded.interpretation: New principal verification of two reused historical investigator reports, both bound to the single authorized original source 6903669a345e76c1dd2958ada4d067bfde06d02f102ce017db06c9a241c7dd51 (Stage336 free_reach, candidate proposal-build, execution 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826). I inspected that source's full 36-field root, both report bodies, and the independent engineering review 54bbe345. Factually both reports reproduce the source exactly; interpretively most scope limits are sound, and I adopt the supported portions while declining three framings: (a) the reach report's claim that the windowed maximum "carries no independent information beyond the ending value" is too strong, since the 0.05 s aggregate maximum still constrains the window aggregate, while what is genuinely absent is window-interior trajectory detail and a continuous-time guarantee; (b) the reach report's "internal tension" labeling of complete/valid execution together with converged_updates=0 and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0, since execution completeness and optimization/plan acceptance are different recorded measures and are not contradictory on their face; (c) the timing report's pooled "(units not stated)" framing of measured_computation_s and mean_complete_update_s, since the "_s" suffixes support a seconds reading while the undefined parts are the clock/timer interval and the mean's denominator, which I state separately. The engineering objection that the reach report cannot erase the recorded task_accepted=false is not supported: the report records task_accepted=false as its own counterevidence/0. The old principal's recorded gate failure (arguments/reason/tool_version wrapper with no interpretation) is a protocol defect of that disposition call, not a content defect of either report, so it does not by itself block accepting the supported portions. Missing independent reach criterion is kept distinct from the recorded official task_accepted=false; missing clock definitions are kept distinct from the seconds-named fields. Historical scope is only this one execution; no new investigator run or scientific computation was performed.

messages.content: Investigate only the scoped evidence. All advertised functions accept their business fields directly, with no arguments/reason/tool_version wrapper. Exactly one native call per turn. Read additional pages with evidence_read; finish with investigation_return. Facts and counterevidence require exact visible source values, one JSON Pointer each, and original source identity. Principal must evaluate support independently and may accept supported portions, defer or reject; suggestions authorize no computation. Principal dispositions use catalog handles and optional extraction-only relative projections. supporting_facts must come from that report; additional_support explicitly marks principal supplemental facts. scope is separate. adopted_claims.statement: Read together, the recorded measured computation per complete update (about 18.35) is far larger than the recorded 0.01 s control period, all 35 control updates are counted as deadline misses, and the run is explicitly not recorded as real_time_demonstrated; the source states no mechanism for the misses, so no causal bottleneck can be identified.
adopted_claims.support_explanation: The magnitude comparison is between two recorded values (mean_complete_update_s 18.34727874570526 vs control_period_s 0.01) and is presented descriptively; the 35/35 miss count and real_time_demonstrated=false are quoted counters/flags, and the report's own counterevidence notes that no field states a cause or mechanism.

adopted_claims.statement: The recorded timing quantities carry '_s' suffixes consistent with a seconds reading, but the record states no clock, timer or interval definition behind measured_computation_s and mean_complete_update_s, no indication whether control_period_s is a simulated step or a wall-clock deadline, and no denominator for mean_complete_update_s; 'seconds-named units' and 'timer/interval undefined' are therefore separate statements.
adopted_claims.support_explanation: The report records the two computation-time values and its counterevidence that the source defines no interval or clock and that /simulation is only an artifact reference. The principal-supplemental fields confirm the '_s'-suffixed names, the bare artifact references, and the 0.35 s simulated duration; nothing in the inspected root supplies a unit declaration, timer definition or denominator, so only a naming-convention seconds reading is warranted.

adopted_claims.statement: The source records identity result_type 'free_reach' for execution 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826 and shows sampled_settling.passed=false with max_error_m 0.06672099201814737 exceeding position_limit_m 0.01, so the timing fields do not by themselves indicate task success.
adopted_claims.support_explanation: The identity field, the /sampled_settling block and the passed flag are quoted exactly from the inspected root; the record's own max_error_m versus position_limit_m comparison is retained as recorded.

dispositions.reason: Accept with adopted_claims narrowed to portions verified against the full 36-field inspected root of 6903669a.... The report's facts on /control_period_s, /control_updates, /simulated_duration_s, /measured_computation_s, /mean_complete_update_s, /deadline_misses, /converged_updates, /real_time_demonstrated, /evaluation_validity, /result_type, /sampled_settling and /terminal_error_m reproduce the source exactly, and its descriptive conclusions (recorded per-update compute far exceeding the recorded control period; 35/35 deadline misses; not real-time demonstrated; run outcome not successful; no mechanism given) are supported. Not adopted as stated: the pooled '(units not stated)' framing of the two computation-time fields, since the '_s' suffixes support a seconds reading while the clock/timer and the mean's denominator remain undefined, which I state separately; and any real-robot/real-time or causal-bottleneck reading. The missing clock definitions are kept distinct from the seconds-named fields, and the old principal's gate failure (wrapper fields, no interpretation) is a protocol defect of that disposition call, not a content defect of this report.
remaining_unknowns: Which clock (wall-clock, CPU or simulated) measured_computation_s denotes is not defined in the source.
The denominator of mean_complete_update_s and whether it covers all 35 updates is not stated.
Whether control_period_s is a simulated step or a wall-clock control deadline is not defined in the source.
Whether deadline_misses records control-loop overrun or another deadline criterion, and the cause of converged_updates=0, are not stated.
Whether real_time_demonstrated=false is build-specific or a general setting is not stated; the referenced configuration, simulation and evaluation artifacts were out of scope.
semantic_claims_unassessed: The timing report's pooled '(units not stated)' characterization of measured_computation_s and mean_complete_update_s is not adopted as stated: the '_s' suffixes support a seconds reading, while what is undefined is the timer/interval definition and the mean's denominator, which I state separately rather than pooling into one unit-unknown statement.
Any reading of these timing fields as real-robot or real-time performance, and any attribution of a dominant causal bottleneck to the deadline misses or non-convergence, remain unassessed.

model_selection.interpretation: New principal verification of the two reused historical investigator reports, both bound to the single authorized original source 6903669a345e76c1dd2958ada4d067bfde06d02f102ce017db06c9a241c7dd51 (Stage336 free_reach, candidate proposal-build, execution 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826). I inspected that source's full 36-field root, both report bodies and the independent engineering review 54bbe345. Factually both reports reproduce the source exactly, so the supported factual portions are accepted with adopted_claims. Interpretively most scope limits are sound, but three framings are not adopted as stated: (a) the reach report's claim that the windowed maximum carries no independent information beyond the ending value is too strong, since the 0.05 s aggregate maximum still constrains the window aggregate, while what is genuinely absent is window-interior trajectory detail and a continuous-time guarantee; (b) the reach report's 'internal tension' labeling of complete/valid execution with converged_updates=0 and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0, since execution completeness and optimization/plan acceptance are different recorded measures and are not contradictory on their face; (c) the timing report's pooled '(units not stated)' framing of measured_computation_s and mean_complete_update_s, since the '_s' suffixes support a seconds reading while the undefined parts are the clock/timer interval and the mean's denominator, which I state separately. The engineering objection that the reach report cannot erase the recorded task_accepted=false is not supported: the report records task_accepted=false as its own counterevidence/0, so the missing independent reach criterion is kept distinct from that recorded official failure. The old principal's gate failure (arguments/reason/tool_version wrapper with no interpretation) is a protocol defect of that disposition call, not a content defect of either report. Historical scope is only this one execution; no new investigator run or scientific computation was performed.
